description: Resident heartbeat/liveness recording of bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY's best bid/ask/last-traded-price, consumed by the monitoring dashboard's freshness check (src/bot/monitoring/aggregate.py's 'spread record' file-age indicator).
source: written by a resident recorder process (see src/bot/monitoring/aggregate.py's consumer for the expected shape; the writer was not conclusively located as a standalone script in this checkout as of 2026-09-05 -- treat as owner-operational infrastructure, re-verify against the running deploy/ scripts if this file's cadence ever looks wrong).
retention: appended forward by the resident recorder; paper_logs/spread_FX_BTC_JPY.csv is the owner-PC operational copy this checkout mirrors, data/spread_FX_BTC_JPY.csv is this checkout's own copy.

best_bid.meaning: best bid price at collection time

best_ask.meaning: best ask price at collection time

ltp.meaning: last traded price at collection time

known_defects: the writing process could not be conclusively identified in this checkout (grepped for spread_FX_BTC_JPY.csv/best_bid+best_ask across src/ and scripts/; only the monitoring consumer in src/bot/monitoring/aggregate.py was found) -- provenance here is inferred from the header and consumer, not confirmed against the writer's own docstring; re-verify before making strong claims about its collection semantics
timestamp is a bare float epoch, not an ISO string like most other datasets in this repo -- do not assume string sorting or ISO parsing will work directly

DATA QA 2026-09-05 (docs/DATA_QA_TRIAGE.md): gaps (42 total = 21 unique events x 2 mirror copies, data/ and paper_logs/, median_gap 5.1s). The two largest examples are a ~10.3h gap ending 2026-08-28T04:19:17Z -- exactly the already-documented 2026-08-27 night to 2026-08-28 morning owner-PC-down window shared by schema/board_round_series_5s.json / schema/venues.json / schema/oi_snapshots.json -- and a further ~10.7h gap ending 2026-08-26T05:16:24Z, a day earlier, that no other currently-shared dataset can cross-confirm (paper_logs/venues/ only starts 2026-08-27; the recorder's own retention doesn't reach further back either), so it is recorded here as a probable second PC-down/sleep event of the same kind but UNCONFIRMED against an independent source. The remaining smaller gaps (194s/50min/2.5h) cluster on 2026-08-20, the very first day of this checkout's collection, consistent with ordinary startup hiccups rather than a defect. Not actioned (operational recorder heartbeat, not a data-quality bug); the unconfirmed 08-25/26 event is noted for anyone with access to the owner PC's own logs from that date to verify.
